```{r}
# ============================================================
# WADA global benchmark files, 2016-2024
# Inputs:
#   wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024_final_sport_names.csv
#   wada_adrv_sport_year_2016_2023_cleaned_for_testing_join.csv
# Outputs:
#   wada_global_sport_year_benchmark_2016_2024.csv
#   wada_global_year_benchmark_2016_2024.csv
# ============================================================

base_dir <- "C:/Users/Apu/Desktop/asl/rstudio files/seminar/project1/data"

testing_file <- file.path(base_dir, "wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024.csv")
adrv_file <- file.path(base_dir, "wada_adrv_sport_year_2016_2023.csv")
out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "wada_global_benchmark_2016_2024")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

safe_div <- function(num, den) {
  if_else(!is.na(den) & den != 0, num / den, NA_real_)
}

clean_num <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all(",", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("%", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("−|–|—", "-") %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    na_if("") %>%
    na_if("-") %>%
    as.numeric()
}



```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read input files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

testing <- read_csv(testing_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    sport_clean = str_trim(as.character(sport_clean)),
    across(
      c(total_samples, in_competition_samples, out_competition_samples,
        urine_samples, blood_samples, dbs_samples, aaf_count),
      clean_num
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2016, year <= 2024)

adrv <- read_csv(adrv_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    sport_clean = str_trim(as.character(sport_clean)),
    across(
      c(analytical_adrv_count, non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
        total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, aaf_outcome_total,
        medical_reasons_count, no_case_to_answer_count, no_sanction_count,
        pending_count, aaf_to_analytical_adrv_rate),
      clean_num
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2016, year <= 2023)


```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare sport-year benchmark
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# The main benchmark is testing-base, because Germany will be compared against
# global testing denominators. ADRV rows without a same-year testing denominator
# are saved as an audit file and still included in the year-level ADRV totals.

testing_bench <- testing %>%
  transmute(
    year,
    sport_clean,
    germany_comparison_join_key = sport_clean,
    
    global_testing_old_sport_names = old_sport_names,
    global_testing_sport_group_tables = sport_group_tables,
    
    global_total_samples = total_samples,
    global_in_competition_samples = in_competition_samples,
    global_out_competition_samples = out_competition_samples,
    global_urine_samples = urine_samples,
    global_blood_samples = blood_samples,
    global_dbs_samples = dbs_samples,
    global_aaf_count = aaf_count,
    
    global_testing_n_source_rows = n_source_rows,
    global_testing_source_reports = source_reports,
    global_testing_source_files = source_files,
    global_testing_source_level_split_issues = source_level_split_issues,
    
    global_testing_row_present = TRUE
  )

adrv_bench <- adrv %>%
  transmute(
    year,
    sport_clean,
    
    global_adrv_old_sport_names = old_adrv_sport_names,
    global_adrv_n_source_rows = n_adrv_source_rows,
    global_adrv_sport_raw_sources = sport_raw_sources,
    global_adrv_sport_category_sources = sport_category_sources,
    global_adrv_source_tables = source_tables,
    
    global_adrv_report_aaf_outcome_total = aaf_outcome_total,
    global_medical_reasons_count = medical_reasons_count,
    global_no_case_to_answer_count = no_case_to_answer_count,
    global_no_sanction_count = no_sanction_count,
    global_pending_count = pending_count,
    
    global_analytical_adrv_count = analytical_adrv_count,
    global_non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated =
      non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
    global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated =
      total_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
    
    global_adrv_report_aaf_to_analytical_adrv_rate =
      aaf_to_analytical_adrv_rate,
    
    global_has_aaf_outcome_data = has_aaf_outcome_data,
    global_has_non_analytical_adrv_data = has_non_analytical_adrv_data,
    
    global_adrv_report_row_present = TRUE
  )

# ADRV rows that cannot be joined to global testing denominators
unmatched_adrv <- anti_join(
  adrv_bench,
  testing_bench,
  by = c("year", "sport_clean")
)

write_csv(
  unmatched_adrv,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_global_benchmark_adrv_rows_not_in_testing.csv")
)

# Full ADRV year totals, including rows that are not joinable to testing
adrv_full_year_totals <- adrv %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    global_year_analytical_adrvs_all_adrv_rows =
      sum(analytical_adrv_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    global_year_non_analytical_adrvs_sport_allocated_all_adrv_rows =
      sum(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    global_year_total_adrvs_sport_allocated_all_adrv_rows =
      sum(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

adrv_available_years <- sort(unique(adrv$year))

sport_year_benchmark <- testing_bench %>%
  left_join(adrv_bench, by = c("year", "sport_clean")) %>%
  left_join(adrv_full_year_totals, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    global_adrv_report_row_present =
      replace_na(global_adrv_report_row_present, FALSE),
    
    global_adrv_data_available = year %in% adrv_available_years
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        global_adrv_report_aaf_outcome_total,
        global_medical_reasons_count,
        global_no_case_to_answer_count,
        global_no_sanction_count,
        global_pending_count,
        global_analytical_adrv_count,
        global_non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
        global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated
      ),
      ~ if_else(
        global_adrv_data_available,
        replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0),
        NA_real_
      )
    ),
    
    global_aaf_rate_per_1000_tests =
      safe_div(global_aaf_count, global_total_samples) * 1000,
    
    global_in_competition_share =
      safe_div(global_in_competition_samples, global_total_samples),
    
    global_out_competition_share =
      safe_div(global_out_competition_samples, global_total_samples),
    
    global_urine_share =
      safe_div(global_urine_samples, global_total_samples),
    
    global_blood_share =
      safe_div(global_blood_samples, global_total_samples),
    
    global_dbs_share =
      safe_div(global_dbs_samples, global_total_samples)
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    global_year_total_samples =
      sum(global_total_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    global_year_aaf_count =
      sum(global_aaf_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    global_year_aaf_rate_per_1000_tests =
      safe_div(global_year_aaf_count, global_year_total_samples) * 1000,
    
    global_testing_share =
      safe_div(global_total_samples, global_year_total_samples),
    
    global_aaf_share =
      safe_div(global_aaf_count, global_year_aaf_count),
    
    # ADRV total from rows that successfully joined to testing
    global_year_total_adrvs_sport_allocated_joinable_to_testing = if_else(
      global_adrv_data_available,
      sum(global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # ADRV total from the full ADRV file, including non-joinable sport rows
    global_year_total_adrvs_sport_allocated = if_else(
      global_adrv_data_available,
      first(global_year_total_adrvs_sport_allocated_all_adrv_rows),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    global_year_analytical_adrvs = if_else(
      global_adrv_data_available,
      first(global_year_analytical_adrvs_all_adrv_rows),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    global_year_non_analytical_adrvs_sport_allocated = if_else(
      global_adrv_data_available,
      first(global_year_non_analytical_adrvs_sport_allocated_all_adrv_rows),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    global_adrv_share_sport_allocated =
      safe_div(
        global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
        global_year_total_adrvs_sport_allocated
      ),
    
    global_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests =
      safe_div(
        global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
        global_total_samples
      ) * 1000,
    
    global_analytical_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests =
      safe_div(
        global_analytical_adrv_count,
        global_total_samples
      ) * 1000,
    
    global_non_analytical_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests =
      safe_div(
        global_non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
        global_total_samples
      ) * 1000,
    
    global_year_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests =
      safe_div(
        global_year_total_adrvs_sport_allocated,
        global_year_total_samples
      ) * 1000,
    
    global_adrv_rate_index_vs_year =
      safe_div(
        global_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests,
        global_year_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests
      ),
    
    global_testing_aaf_to_analytical_adrv_rate =
      safe_div(global_analytical_adrv_count, global_aaf_count),
    
    global_testing_vs_adrv_gap =
      global_adrv_share_sport_allocated - global_testing_share,
    
    global_adrv_to_testing_share_ratio =
      safe_div(
        global_adrv_share_sport_allocated,
        global_testing_share
      ),
    
    global_testing_volume_rank_in_year =
      min_rank(desc(global_total_samples)),
    
    global_aaf_count_rank_in_year =
      min_rank(desc(global_aaf_count)),
    
    global_adrv_count_rank_in_year =
      min_rank(desc(global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated)),
    
    benchmark_min_100_tests =
      global_total_samples >= 100,
    
    benchmark_min_500_tests =
      global_total_samples >= 500,
    
    benchmark_min_1000_tests =
      global_total_samples >= 1000,
    
    # FIXED:
    # Rank is calculated only among sports with at least 100 tests.
    # This avoids rank gaps caused by low-testing sports being ranked first
    # and then removed afterwards.
    global_adrv_rate_rank_min_100_tests_in_year = if_else(
      benchmark_min_100_tests & global_adrv_data_available,
      min_rank(desc(if_else(
        benchmark_min_100_tests,
        global_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests,
        NA_real_
      ))),
      NA_integer_
    ),
    
    # FIXED:
    # Same logic for AAF-rate ranking.
    global_aaf_rate_rank_min_100_tests_in_year = if_else(
      benchmark_min_100_tests,
      min_rank(desc(if_else(
        benchmark_min_100_tests,
        global_aaf_rate_per_1000_tests,
        NA_real_
      ))),
      NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    usable_for_testing_benchmark =
      !is.na(global_total_samples) & global_total_samples > 0,
    
    usable_for_adrv_rate_benchmark =
      usable_for_testing_benchmark & global_adrv_data_available,
    
    adrv_counts_filled_zero_because_no_sport_report_row =
      global_adrv_data_available & !global_adrv_report_row_present
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, global_testing_volume_rank_in_year, sport_clean)

write_csv(
  sport_year_benchmark,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_global_sport_year_benchmark_2016_2024.csv")
)

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Year-level benchmark
# ------------------------------------------------------------

official_totals <- tribble(
  ~year, ~global_official_total_adrvs_including_non_sport, ~global_official_total_note,
  2016, 1595, "Official total includes 21 athlete support personnel cases not allocated by sport.",
  2017, 1804, "Official total includes 28 athlete support personnel cases; sport-detail analytical rows are 2 below official analytical total.",
  2018, 1923, "Official total includes 16 athlete support personnel cases; report has minor one-case wording inconsistency.",
  2019, 1914, "Official total includes 26 athlete support personnel cases not allocated by sport.",
  2020, 935,  "Official total includes 25 athlete support personnel cases not allocated by sport.",
  2021, 1388, "Official total uses Executive Summary logic with 32 athlete support personnel cases; sport-level file excludes ASP.",
  2022, 1652, "Official total includes 31 athlete support personnel cases not allocated by sport.",
  2023, 2005, "Official total includes 8 non-sport/Unknown ASP cases excluded from sport benchmark.",
  2024, NA_real_, "ADRV report not available in this dataset."
)

year_testing <- sport_year_benchmark %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    global_adrv_data_available = first(global_adrv_data_available),
    global_total_samples = sum(global_total_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_in_competition_samples = sum(global_in_competition_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_out_competition_samples = sum(global_out_competition_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_urine_samples = sum(global_urine_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_blood_samples = sum(global_blood_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_dbs_samples = sum(global_dbs_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_aaf_count = sum(global_aaf_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated_joinable_to_testing = if_else(
      first(global_adrv_data_available),
      sum(global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    global_sports_tested = n_distinct(sport_clean),
    global_sports_with_aafs = sum(global_aaf_count > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

year_adrv_full <- adrv %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    global_analytical_adrv_count = sum(analytical_adrv_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated =
      sum(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated = sum(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_sports_with_adrv_report_row = n_distinct(sport_clean),
    global_sports_with_adrvs = sum(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

year_benchmark <- year_testing %>%
  left_join(year_adrv_full, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    global_aaf_rate_per_1000_tests = safe_div(global_aaf_count, global_total_samples) * 1000,
    global_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests_sport_allocated =
      safe_div(global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, global_total_samples) * 1000,
    global_analytical_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests =
      safe_div(global_analytical_adrv_count, global_total_samples) * 1000,
    global_non_analytical_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests_sport_allocated =
      safe_div(global_non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated, global_total_samples) * 1000,
    global_in_competition_share = safe_div(global_in_competition_samples, global_total_samples),
    global_out_competition_share = safe_div(global_out_competition_samples, global_total_samples),
    global_urine_share = safe_div(global_urine_samples, global_total_samples),
    global_blood_share = safe_div(global_blood_samples, global_total_samples),
    global_dbs_share = safe_div(global_dbs_samples, global_total_samples),
    global_sports_with_100plus_tests = map_int(year, ~ sum(sport_year_benchmark$year == .x & sport_year_benchmark$global_total_samples >= 100, na.rm = TRUE)),
    global_sports_with_1000plus_tests = map_int(year, ~ sum(sport_year_benchmark$year == .x & sport_year_benchmark$global_total_samples >= 1000, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  left_join(official_totals, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    global_official_minus_sport_allocated_adrvs =
      global_official_total_adrvs_including_non_sport - global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated
  ) %>%
  select(
    year, global_adrv_data_available,
    global_total_samples, global_in_competition_samples, global_out_competition_samples,
    global_urine_samples, global_blood_samples, global_dbs_samples,
    global_aaf_count, global_aaf_rate_per_1000_tests,
    global_in_competition_share, global_out_competition_share,
    global_urine_share, global_blood_share, global_dbs_share,
    global_analytical_adrv_count, global_non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
    global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
    global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated_joinable_to_testing,
    global_official_total_adrvs_including_non_sport,
    global_official_minus_sport_allocated_adrvs,
    global_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests_sport_allocated,
    global_analytical_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests,
    global_non_analytical_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests_sport_allocated,
    global_sports_tested, global_sports_with_aafs, global_sports_with_adrv_report_row,
    global_sports_with_adrvs, global_sports_with_100plus_tests, global_sports_with_1000plus_tests,
    global_official_total_note
  )

write_csv(year_benchmark, file.path(out_dir, "wada_global_year_benchmark_2016_2024.csv"))

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Validation summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

validation_summary <- year_benchmark %>%
  select(year, global_total_samples, global_aaf_count,
         global_analytical_adrv_count,
         global_non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
         global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
         global_sports_tested, global_sports_with_adrv_report_row) %>%
  left_join(
    testing %>%
      group_by(year) %>%
      summarise(
        expected_testing_rows = n(),
        expected_total_samples = sum(total_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
        expected_aaf_count = sum(aaf_count, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "year"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    adrv %>%
      group_by(year) %>%
      summarise(
        expected_adrv_rows = n(),
        expected_analytical_adrvs = sum(analytical_adrv_count, na.rm = TRUE),
        expected_non_analytical_adrvs = sum(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
        expected_total_adrvs = sum(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "year"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_diff_vs_testing_file = global_total_samples - expected_total_samples,
    aaf_diff_vs_testing_file = global_aaf_count - expected_aaf_count,
    analytical_adrv_diff_vs_adrv_file = global_analytical_adrv_count - expected_analytical_adrvs,
    non_analytical_adrv_diff_vs_adrv_file = global_non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated - expected_non_analytical_adrvs,
    total_adrv_diff_vs_adrv_file = global_total_adrv_count_sport_allocated - expected_total_adrvs,
    unmatched_adrv_rows_not_in_sport_year_benchmark = map_int(year, ~ sum(unmatched_adrv$year == .x))
  )

write_csv(validation_summary, file.path(out_dir, "wada_global_benchmark_validation_summary.csv"))

cat("Saved global benchmark files in:", out_dir, "\n")

```
